title: The Demon Hunter [Chang Yuan Tu] Episode 102 Indonesia, English Sub
description:
English

Meng Chuan witnessed his mother killed before his eyes, so he trained very hard hoping to one day avenge her death. But his peaceful days were broken as his wedding engagement being called off, an invasion by foreign forces, the sanctuary fallen into enemy hands… In order to protect the people of Ning City, he picked up his sword and vowed to be the strongest. This is a heavy responsibility and a long journey…

Indonesia

Meng Chuan menyaksikan ibunya terbunuh di depan matanya, jadi dia berlatih sangat keras berharap suatu hari membalas kematiannya. Tapi hari-harinya yang damai hancur karena pertunangan pernikahannya dibatalkan, invasi oleh pasukan asing, tempat perlindungan jatuh ke tangan musuh ... Untuk melindungi orang-orang di Kota Ning, dia mengambil pedangnya dan bersumpah untuk menjadi yang terkuat. Ini adalah tanggung jawab yang berat dan perjalanan panjang ...
